_help: Your own defaults for Parts & final mix and for every render. Change a number, save the file - no restart needed. A choice on the web page wins over this file; a story's own "settings" win over this file too.
_cut_parts_help: 0 = one part per scene. A number = cut long scenes into parts of this many seconds (5 or more), e.g. 5, 10, 15.
_save_every_help: While a part / video renders, save it every this many seconds (5 or more) so Stop / Resume loses little work. "n4" = in 4 pieces. 0 = in one go.
_world_detail_help: Stories in a big world map: "low" (fastest, least RAM), "medium" or "high" (the whole world). Empty = low for quick previews, high for the real video.
